sourceText:
Satay Babi
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 12:49pm

Ingredients




2 pounds Pork loin
1 Thai chile
4 Garlic clove
2 Onion, med
2 tablespoons Ketjap manis
2 tablespoons Oil, divided
1 teaspoon Cumin
1 teaspoon Cilantro
teaspoon Galangal
teaspoon Turmeric

Preparation

1 Cook Time: 9:00 Cut porkloin into 1" cubes. Grind together cumin, cilantro, galangal, and turmeric. 2 Grind together Thai chile, garlic and onion in a food processor. Add the bomboe sasate mixture and marinate meat cubes in this an hour or more 3 (overnight preferable). Fry half the meat in a little oil, adding a tablespoon of ketjap manis, until cooked. Remove to a bowl and cook the remaining meat. Allow the meat to cool. Thread on bamboo skewers. At this point, they can be frozen for later use. Grill over charcoal or bake in a 350 F oven until heated through. Use the pan drippings/cooked marinade in the saus ka=87ang.
